identity.title: Implement stable analysis domain and API route

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Turn the OpenAIRE snapshot into one stable AnalysisResult API contract. Keep provider payloads internal and keep the route boring.
human_pressure.why_now: A stable narrow contract lets UI, tests and submission export converge quickly.
do_not_misread: This is a 40-hour effective deadline build, not a platform foundation exercise.
Preserve the IDEA → ANALYZE → POTENTIAL GAP → WHY → EVIDENCE → REFINE user loop.

machine_core.goal: Implement TopicAnalysisRequest validation, AnalysisResult domain types, POST /api/analyze orchestration shell and explicit error responses.
invariants: AnalysisResult is the single UI/export contract.
Missing provider metrics never become a valid gap result.

steps.title: Implement analysis orchestration shell
details: Return explicit provider failure without a fabricated finding.

acceptance: POST /api/analyze has a stable success shape.
Provider-specific fields do not leak into AnalysisResult.

must_check: POST /api/analyze has a stable success shape.

reject_if: Work expands beyond the declared file scope.

validation_notes: Greenfield task suite. Paths are established by earlier packs; run sequentially. Validation commands intentionally use repository-level npm scripts created by the scaffold pack instead of guessed test filenames unless the pack explicitly creates that test file.
expected_coder_final_response: Concise implementation summary, changed files, validation results, and an Evidence Matrix mapping acceptance items to concrete evidence.
